top_signals.title: Pakistan Rejects Costly LNG Cargo as Blackout Risk Deepens
top_signals.summary: Pakistan may have to extend rolling blackouts after it refused to pay three times the pre-war price for an LNG cargo, which was the only offer its latest emergency tender drew. The single cargo, offered by BP, was priced at $27 per million British thermal units, Bloomberg reported, citing unnamed trading sources. “The international LNG price is around $23.18 per MMBtu, whereas the bid received was $26.969 per MMBtu. top_signals.summary: According to a five-year bear management plan, the Tokyo government will aim to cull about 34 bears a year to keep the number of bears in the area from increasing.
